description: Does a declared PARAMETERS name work as the TOP argument: TOP pn, TOP [pn], TOP (pn) with pn Long = 2, TOP pn PERCENT with pn Double = 30, and TOP pn with pn Text = '2'? For each temporary QueryDef the Parameters (Name, Type, Direction) are read, the value is assigned and read back, then the QueryDef is opened as a snapshot with Fields Name/Type/Size, every row, Close and DBEngine.Errors. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text goes into a temporary QueryDef (CreateQueryDef with an empty name, then DBEngine.Errors).
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
